title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): code blocks preview code, charts and diagrams inline in Chat
summary: The briefing passes: its roadmap facts, licensing statements and code-preview policy are supported, and it distinguishes the existing preview policy from the planned inline layout. Minor corrections should include the policy scope-selection step and classify the layout change as preparation rather than an optional capability to review.
